title_en: Stories of Modern China (6/20): Home for the New Year
note_en: 得 can link a feeling to its result: 妈妈激动得说不出话来 "Mom was so moved she couldn't say a word." Here what follows 得 is a whole clause describing the effect, much like English "so ... that ..."; compare the simpler 剪得很慢 "cut slowly," where 得 is followed by just an adjective describing the manner.
